data.title: Selection
data.tagline: Show which text or items the user has selected
data.description: Selection highlights the text, rows, files, or objects included in the next action. Keep it distinct from hover and focus, and make the selected set remain clear while menus or toolbars open. The visual state should match the actual data selection.

use: Choose rows for a bulk action
Keep a current item visibly chosen
avoid: Use the same style for hover, focus, and selection
Show a selected appearance before the data is selected
Rely on color alone for important item selection

lessonPractice.title: Selected article text uses brand blue behind gray copy and is barely readable, and the team wants to block copying. What should change?

options.label: Use a high-contrast selection for body text, allow copying, and disable selection only on drag handles
options.feedback: Selection must remain visible and body copying is normal; prevention belongs only where selection interferes with an operation.

options.label: Keep the brand blue and gray text because brand compliance is more important
options.feedback: Brand consistency cannot replace selection readability; low contrast hides what users selected.

options.label: Apply user-select: none to the entire article so accidental selection cannot happen
options.feedback: Body copy is not a drag control, and global prevention blocks copying, quoting, and assistive reading tasks.

data.agentPrompt: Use brand-aligned ::selection colors that remain readable in light and dark themes, and keep body text selectable and copyable. Restrict user-select: none to explicit drag handles, then verify keyboard copy and selection scope.
